title: Lost in Phonation: Voice Quality Variation as an Evaluation Dimension for Speech Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.25577v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Speech Foundation Models (SFMs) enable direct processing of raw audio, allowing models to respond to subtle paralinguistic variation. However, how these models interpret non-lexical cues remains largely unstudied. We introduce VQ-Bench, a controlled evaluation suite featuring a parallel dataset of synthesized modal, breathy, creaky, and end-creak phonation types. We evaluate SFM sensitivity through open-ended generation across four ecologically valid domains, alongside speech emotion recognition. Our results reveal performance gaps: while a leading commercial API failed basic biometric sanity checks, other models exhibited systematic shifts in agency, empathy, and leadership based on phonation. Our findings also highlight gender asymmetries in salary and leadership endorsements, demonstrating that SFMs may mirror or amplify human social biases. translated_title: 迷失在发声状态中：语音质量变化作为语音基础模型的评估维度
translated_abstract: 近期语音基础模型（SFMs）的进展使得直接处理原始音频成为可能，使模型能够响应微妙的副语言变化。然而，这些模型如何解读非词汇线索在很大程度上仍未得到研究。我们引入了VQ-Bench，一个受控评估套件，包含一个平行数据集，涵盖合成的气声、气息声、嘎裂声和末端嘎裂声等发声类型。我们通过四个生态有效领域中的开放式生成以及语音情感识别来评估SFM的敏感性。结果揭示了性能差距：虽然一个领先的商业API未能通过基本生物识别健全性检查，其他模型则根据发声类型表现出能动性、共情和领导力的系统性变化。我们的发现还突显了在薪资和领导力认可方面的性别不对称，表明SFM可能反映或放大人类的社会偏见。这项工作建立了一个可复现的框架，以确保负责任的应用。
tldr: 该研究提出了VQ-Bench评估套件，揭示了语音基础模型在发声质量变化下表现出性能差距和性别偏见，为负责任的语音AI评估提供了新框架。
en_tdlr: This work introduces VQ-Bench, revealing performance gaps and gender biases in speech foundation models under phonation variation, offering a reproducible framework for responsible speech AI evaluation.
